text.p: Roper Industries Inc said Friday it has completed its acquisition of Princeton Instruments Inc for $37.4 million in cash and $3.0 million worth of Roper stock.

It said it expects to complete its acquisition of Petrotech Inc by June 2. Roper previously announced it would buy Petrotech for $6.5 million in cash and $6.5 million in Roper stock and assume about $9 million of its debt.
Roper is an international manufacturer of fluid handling, industrial control and analytical instrumentation products.
Princeton designs, makes and markets spectral digital imaging cameras.
Petrotect provides system intergration of control products and systems for turbines and compressors in the oil and gas, pipeline, process control and power generation industries.
